bottlenecks.name: Single-scale Patching and Fixed Resolution
bottlenecks.measurable_evidence: PatchTST uses fixed PATCH_LEN=16 and STRIDE=8, mapping 360 inputs into 44 tokens. Embedded dimension is hardcoded at 128.
bottlenecks.impact_on_performance: Limits model's capacity to represent multi-scale features (e.g. fast solar spikes vs slow background decay). The model has only 822,401 parameters, underutilizing capacity relative to 5.1M training rows.

bottlenecks.name: Under-converged Training
bottlenecks.measurable_evidence: Training history contains only 3 epochs. Training loss dropped from 0.0699 to 0.0539, and validation loss dropped from 0.0757 to 0.0725. Both curves show active downward slopes without plateauing.
bottlenecks.impact_on_performance: The model has not reached convergence, indicating that the baseline model is under-trained and likely sub-optimal.

bottlenecks.name: Omission of Multi-Instrument Inputs
bottlenecks.measurable_evidence: Feature columns are restricted to 14 GOES-only features. Processed Aditya-L1 telemetry (SoLEXS and HEL1OS) parquets containing rate and counts are present on disk but never loaded or merged.
bottlenecks.impact_on_performance: The model is blind to soft and hard X-ray measurements from the Aditya-L1 observatory, which provide vital spatial and spectral constraints on flaring regions.

bottlenecks.name: Split Class Imbalance Shift
bottlenecks.measurable_evidence: Positive target rate in train split is 0.62% (31,993 / 5,160,952), validation split is 4.07% (63,849 / 1,568,399), and test split is 23.20% (419,150 / 1,806,313).
bottlenecks.impact_on_performance: Forces the model to operate under severe non-stationarity and class distribution shift, causing validation-tuned thresholds to mismatch test-set label densities.

bottlenecks.name: Non-Parametric Step Mapping
bottlenecks.measurable_evidence: Isotonic Regression calibrator maps continuous raw probabilities to a discrete step function (e.g., mapping multiple distinct raw probabilities to exactly 0.06027905 or 1.0).
bottlenecks.impact_on_performance: Reduces resolution of forecast probability outputs and prevents fine-grained operator risk differentiation.

bottlenecks.name: Slow Monte Carlo Dropout Inference
bottlenecks.measurable_evidence: Epistemic uncertainty requires n_dropout_samples=50 forward passes on the model at every time-step during inference.
bottlenecks.impact_on_performance: High computational overhead for real-time nowcasting. Also, the model lack aleatoric uncertainty prediction.
